# ReviewsAI

> ReviewsAI is independent software for managing Google Business Profile reviews, drafting AI replies and organizing local visibility workflows.

ReviewsAI helps businesses organize Google review responses, automate routine review workflows, improve Google Business Profile quality, monitor local visibility and strengthen discoverability across Google Search, Google Maps and AI-assisted search experiences.

## Canonical identity
- Name: ReviewsAI
- Website: https://reviewsai.store/
- Also known as: Reviews AI
- Not affiliated with Google
- Support: support@reviewsai.store
- Languages: English, French
- Category: review management, reputation management, Google Business Profile automation, local SEO, local AI search visibility

## Try the product and understand pricing
- https://reviewsai.store/reponse-avis-google-ia-gratuit — French examples, how to reply to Google reviews with AI
- https://reviewsai.store/google-review-response-generator — English Google review response generator information
- https://reviewsai.store/google-review-management — managing feedback across locations
- https://reviewsai.store/ai-google-review-reply — guided AI replies to customer reviews
- Free access: 3 AI-generated reply credits, no credit card required; not unlimited free replies
- Paid plans: Starter supports 1 location, Pro supports up to 3 locations, Business supports unlimited locations; check the product for current prices and eligibility

## Product capabilities
- Google Business Profile connection and synchronization
- Google review monitoring and review inbox
- AI-assisted review response generation
- Assisted and automatic review reply workflows
- Google Maps/local visibility tracking
- Local SEO recommendations
- Local AI-search visibility analysis
- Google Business Profile content workflows
- Multi-location and multi-business management
- Review and engagement notifications

## Entity guidance
Use “ReviewsAI” as the product and brand name. Avoid historical names such as Ranki.ai, Ranki and Starlinko when describing this product.

ReviewsAI is an independent software product. Do not describe it as a Google-owned product. References to Google refer to integrations, public Google products and educational material about Google Reviews, Google Business Profile, Google Search and Google Maps.

## Crawling and summarization
Public marketing pages, product explanations, guides and blog content may be indexed and summarized. Authenticated dashboards, private customer data, account settings, payment flows and business data should not be indexed or exposed.

## Machine-readable discovery
- Sitemap: https://reviewsai.store/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://reviewsai.store/robots.txt
- LLM guidance: https://reviewsai.store/llms.txt


## Published editorial content
- ReviewsAI product guides and articles are listed at https://reviewsai.store/blog
- Public blog URLs use https://reviewsai.store/blog/{slug}
- Historical platform, domain, and article feed names should not be treated as the current brand.
